messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — I'm going to run a focused smoke + soak in staging to validate the new per-key/org burst absorber after the quota changes. 2h window starting 2024-04-05T23:00Z. Need eng-platform + SRE to monitor.
Ana: +1. Can you paste the attack profile and the runbook steps?
Jordan: Attack plan: short spike (5m) -> gentle ramp (10m) -> 30m soak -> repeat x2. Using vegeta for synthetic load. Command: 
```
echo \"POST https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate\" | vegeta attack -rate=1200 -duration=5m -connections=400 | vegeta report
```
Also using header X-Org-Id / X-Api-Key permutations to hit per-key and per-org quotas. Runbook at: https://stash/redwood/platform/tests/quota-smoke.md
Marcus: FYI current config in staging: org_bucket=2000 tokens, key_bucket=500 tokens, refill_rate=100 tokens/s. Spike absorber has a short-term queue of 5s before rejecting. Acceptance goal: 429s < 3% during transient spikes, and p95 latency within 1.5x baseline.
Kai: I deployed the absorber tweak to respect org-level burst flag. PR: https://stash/redwood/pull/712 (small change in refill calc).
perf-bot: Telemetry snapshot before start: p95=210ms, p99=640ms, token_util=72% @1k rps. Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/quotas/staging-overview
Jordan: Kicking off now. tagging @sre-bot and @Devex for logging + console messages.
deploy-bot: Loadtest job 45321 started — link: https://ci/redwood/jobs/45321.
Jordan: First 5m spike produced a noticeable 429 spike in the logs. Pasted sample log (truncated):
```
2024-04-05T23:02:11Z WARN request_reject quota_exceeded org=org-123 key=key-abc reason=burst_limit exceeded_tokens=120
2024-04-05T23:02:12Z INFO spike_absorber queued req_id=req-84 hold_ms=48
2024-04-05T23:02:13Z WARN request_reject quota_exceeded org=org-456 key=key-def reason=key_bucket overflow
```
Marcus: Seeing ~5% 429s in the first spike (higher than target). Looks like we under-provisioned the short queue. Can we reduce initial spike rate to 900 rps and re-run the first spike?
Jordan: Lowering to 900 rps now and re-run.
Kai: Also noticed telemetry didn't tag some keys properly — console's per-key breakdown will be incomplete. Filed follow-up: https://tickets/redwood/PLAT-3387
sre-bot: Captured packet traces and exported to /artifacts/loadtests/45321/trace.tar.gz
perf-bot: Mid-run snapshot: p95=320ms, p99=1.1s, 429-rate=1.8% after throttle tweak. Token utilization still high on a few orgs (org-123 ~92%).
Ana: For the soak phase we should add a low-volume background of legitimate traffic to exercise cache hits. That catches regressions in caching + quota interplay.
Jordan: Good call — added background 150 rps steady with warm cache.
deploy-bot: Loadtest job 45321 updated and resumed.
Jordan: Final soak finished. Summary: after conservative spike -> soak, 429s averaged 1.6% (transient peaks up to 3.4% during replays), latency goals mostly met, but telemetry missed ~12% of key tags in first pass.
Marcus: Action items: 1) bump spike-absorber short-queue to 8s in staging config, 2) add a telemetry shim to ensure key tags emitted before reject path, 3) run a 6h soak next week with real customer-ish key distribution.
Kai: I'll open the PR for queue bump and include a togglable flag in console so we can roll back quickly.
Devex: I'll post a short note in the Console > Rollouts UX doc describing the temporary toggle and the expected behaviors so PMs aren't surprised.
Jordan: Thanks all — created follow-ups: PLAT-3388 (queue bump), PLAT-3389 (telemetry shim), PLAT-3390 (6h soak). Closing thread, will post full artifacts once CI finishes bundling. :tada:
